subject: reasoning
question: URKE is related to QOGB in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, EFUS is related to ACQP. To which of the given options is SWIJ related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, URKE is related to QOGB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dda7d186681f6d4aff0ce8beeaf95be61b1d9317bf6e49fcca4cb1f3c7ebeaea.png] 

For, EFUS is related to ACQP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae74cc64546a21206c129e0978f00118b4caf62d50ed39fed633bf1aaf4a1102.png] 

Similarly, for **SWIJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9693df9200ade54ef36e8403d83f728ddf0439016c8ee891e4c1a1ff1d2fe1be.png] 

So, SWIJ will be related to **OTEG**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
